note: Svalbard's bank is an office of a Norwegian bank: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge says on its own page (read 2026-10-30) that it has 38 offices in 36 municipalities in Nordland, Troms, Finnmark and Svalbard. So an account there is that Norwegian bank's, numbered as one in Norway (an IBAN with Norway's structure). SWIFT's IBAN Registry doesn't fold Svalbard into Norway's prefix; this follows the bank, not the registry.
